title.en: Help mom get the trash, please.

content.en: Help mom get the trash, please.

title.zh: 不要把头探到窗户外面
title.en: Don't stick your head out the window.

content.zh: 不要把头探到窗户外面
content.en: Don't stick your head out the window.

title.zh: 你可以和妈妈一起晾衣服吗
title.en: Can you hang the laundry with mom?

content.zh: 你可以和妈妈一起晾衣服吗
content.en: Can you hang the laundry with mom?

title.zh: 你可以帮我递一下衣架吗
title.en: Can you pass me the hanger, please?

content.zh: 你可以帮我递一下衣架吗
content.en: Can you pass me the hanger, please?

title.en: Hang the clothes on the hangers, please.

content.en: Hang the clothes on the hangers, please.

title.zh: 衣服干了我们去收衣服吧
title.en: The clothes are dry. Let's go and get them.

content.zh: 衣服干了我们去收衣服吧
content.en: The clothes are dry. Let's go and get them.

title.zh: 你可以拿个新的垃圾袋过来吗
title.en: Can you get a new trash bag, please?

content.zh: 你可以拿个新的垃圾袋过来吗
content.en: Can you get a new trash bag, please?

title.zh: 把垃圾袋打开套在垃圾桶上
title.en: Open the trash bag and put it in the trash can.

content.zh: 把垃圾袋打开套在垃圾桶上
content.en: Open the trash bag and put it in the trash can.
